products.name: Automated Liquid Filler Pro
products.short_description: 12,000 bph liquid filling with 0.1% volume accuracy.
products.description: The Automated Liquid Filler Pro is engineered for beverage, dairy, and personal-care plants that need speed without sacrificing fill accuracy. Servo-controlled nozzles, CIP-ready piping, and a hygienic stainless frame make it a flagship line for regulated production.

products.name: Vacuum Sealer X-1000
products.short_description: Industrial-grade continuous vacuum sealing for food and medical packs.
products.description: A heavy-duty chamber sealer designed for continuous shifts. Dual sealing bars, programmable vacuum cycles, and MAP gas flush keep product shelf life consistent across meat, cheese, and sterile medical kits.

products.name: Powder Dosing Unit PD-50
products.short_description: Volumetric, dust-free powder dosing for jars, pouches, and tins.
products.description: Auger dosing with a closed hopper and dust extraction keeps the plant clean while holding tight fill weights on spices, protein, and pharma powders.

products.name: Complete Bottling Line BL-12K
products.short_description: Turnkey rinse-fill-cap-label line for water and juice plants.
products.description: A complete production line covering rinsing, filling, capping, coding, labeling, and shrink wrapping. Bosco project engineers handle layout, installation, and operator training.

products.name: Conveyor Belt Master
products.short_description: Heavy-duty modular belt with variable-speed drive.
products.description: Sanitary modular belt conveyor for wet and dry areas. Variable speed, stainless side frames, and quick-release belt for washdown.

products.name: Flow Wrap System FW-800
products.short_description: Continuous flow wrapping for bakery, confectionery, and hardware.
products.description: Servo film feed and a sanitary infeed keep packs tight and aligned at high speed. Ideal for factories that need one wrapper to handle multiple SKU lengths.

products.name: Food-Grade HDPE Resin
products.short_description: Certified food-contact HDPE for bottles, caps, and containers.
products.description: Consistent melt flow and documented food-contact compliance for converters supplying beverage and dairy plants across Egypt and the GCC.

products.name: Pharmaceutical Lactose Excipient
products.short_description: GMP lactose monohydrate for tablet and capsule production.
products.description: Pharma-grade lactose sourced from audited facilities, with full DMF support and batch documentation for regulated manufacturers.

products.name: Servo Motor SM-400
products.short_description: High-torque servo motor for fillers, wrappers, and conveyors.
products.description: Drop-in servo replacement used across Bosco filling and packaging lines. Supplied with encoder cable and mounting kit.

products.name: Photoelectric Sensor Kit
products.short_description: Line-ready photoelectric sensors for product detect and reject.
products.description: A 12-piece industrial sensor kit with brackets and M12 leads, tuned for bottle, carton, and pouch detection on Bosco lines.

products.name: Rotary Volumetric Filler R-240
products.short_description: Compact rotary volumetric filler for oils, sauces, and chemicals.
products.description: A 12-head rotary filler that handles viscous and foaming products with piston or flow-meter options. Built for plants that need reliability in a smaller footprint.
